# Parley v0.1.9

This beta gives Parley a distinctive application icon built around the
product's defining idea: independent panes meeting through one visible,
supervised coordination point.

## New application icon

- A new **shared roundtable** mark replaces the generic opposing-chevron icon.
- Four inward-facing pane segments represent independent participants, while
  the cobalt segment identifies the active pane and the central opening keeps
  coordination visible.
- The graphite, cobalt and warm-white mark remains legible at Dock, Finder and
  menu sizes without using text, vendor branding or decorative AI imagery.
- The application contains a transparent 1024 px source and a compiled macOS
  ICNS with ten native representations from 16 px through 1024 px.
- Development and packaged Production builds use the same icon asset.

## Upgrade notes

- This release changes application artwork and build identity only. Workspace
  definitions, panes, coordination records and terminal behavior are
  unchanged.
- Agent protocol v9 is unchanged, so panes already carrying v9 do not need a
  protocol restart for this release.

## Install and trust

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- At least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.9-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app` in
  Applications, and reopen it normally from Finder.
- This beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. Use **System Settings >
  Privacy & Security > Open Anyway** only when the files came from this expected
  release. Never disable Gatekeeper globally.

Use `Parley-0.1.9-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
